name: Shirakawa Kotori
source: Kotori is the school's idol and star singer. [spoiler]Although she can hear other people's thoughts, she carefully hides this ability.[/spoiler] She became close to [url=/c4020]Jun'ichi[/url] because he was the only one in the male student body that didn't try to idolize her. She has a habit of using cute greetings to people she feels especially close to.
